findings.title: `openspec/changes/archive/` is excluded from union mode but not from change-id derivation - every archive PR derives `--change archive`, or fails as ambiguous
findings.one_line: Archive PRs are the most routine OpenSpec PR class in this repo; the plan's derivation rule returns the literal string `archive` for them (or two ids, hard-failing as ambiguous), and which of the two happens depends on an unstated `git diff` rename-detection flag.

findings.title: D12 self-contradiction: design.md:494-495 states the ambiguity rule unqualified, now false for merge_group
wp-wiring's test-file mapping now points at a nine-scenario line, two of which are gate-verdict not wiring
merge-group-ignores-unbatched-changes asserts a resolution property but is owned only by the wiring task
5.7c's 'record but do not gate' half names no destination artifact

briefs_cleared.C1_merge_group_satisfiable: PASS - `--change <id>` resolution is a function of openspec/specs/ and openspec/changes/<id>/specs/ only; other in-flight changes are actively unreachable via other-changes-are-invisible. Tree presence cannot leak. The fix removes R6-F1 rather than moving it.
briefs_cleared.C2_invariant: PASS - all seven described invocations enumerated; six blocking all supply --change, one union run is non-blocking, 5.7c's union probe is explicitly ungated.
briefs_cleared.C3_stale_consequence: FAIL - R7-F1. Seven for seven: union mode learned to exclude archive/, the derivation rule one paragraph below did not. R7-N1 and R7-N2 are lesser instances of the same pattern.
briefs_cleared.C4_new_scenarios_and_5_7c: PASS for both new scenarios (red-before / green-after testable in the harness 5.7 already mandates). 5.7c's 'record but do not gate' is not mechanically verifiable but is no weaker than the [human] task containing it - fyi only.
briefs_cleared.C5_dispatch_readiness: PASS apart from R7-F1. openspec validate --strict valid; 58 scenarios; work-packages parses; all seven [human] tasks correctly carved out of every package.

recommended_action: PLAN_FIX. R7-F1 is a one-paragraph fix in the spec delta plus three mirrors, and R7-N1/N2/N3/I1 are cheap to fold into the same commit. Do not dispatch to IMPLEMENT until the derivation rule states that `archive/` is not a derivable change directory on either blocking event and that an archive-only diff is the SKIP.
notes: reviews/consensus-plan.json was ignored as instructed. Round 6's findings preserved at reviews/review-findings-plan-r6.json. This agent made no state transitions and did not touch loop-state.json.
